tools.name: workflow_close
tools.title: Workflow Close
tools.description: Create or return an immutable snapshot of this job's eligible receipts. Repeating the call with unchanged receipt data returns the same snapshot workflow_id; later calls after new receipts create a separate snapshot while session_workflow_id continues identifying the live ledger. Both identifiers are unbound metadata excluded from canonical receipt bytes. The first close returns a one-time private workflow_manage_token; retries do not rotate or reissue it. The workflow_close summary receipt is excluded from the step count. Records Zambo's claims, not issuer authentication.
